title: New Update Available: TheDesiTadka v1.2.2
message:
We have released TheDesiTadka v1.2.2 with major video playback and playlist improvements:

• Seamless Auto-Pagination: Reached the end of a category or provider page? Swiping or clicking 'Next' now automatically loads the next page from the site and plays the next video seamlessly!
• Fixed 'No Content Left' Bug: Resolved playlist reset issues so all videos loaded on your screen remain accessible during playback.
• Improved Next / Previous Controls: Smooth button and swipe gesture navigation across Player and Video Details screens.
• Enhanced Stability: Optimized memory and stream resolution across all 73 providers.

Tap 'Update Now' to download and install the latest version.
